item.title: Westminster man pleads guilty to federal terrorism charge
item.description: A Westminster man accused of trying to travel overseas to join the Islamic State group pleaded guilty to one count of providing financing for terrorism in federal court, according to court records.

item.title: PHOTOS: Puppy Bowl 2026 at Denver International Airport
item.description: Denver International Airport and the Denver Animal Shelter hosted the annual DEN Puppy Bowl in the Jeppesen Terminal at the airport in Denver on Friday, Feb. 6, 2026. Pets featured at the event will be available for adoption on Feb. 8 at Denver Animal Shelter.
